# `pkg` command

Packages built for your compiler and installed in a store (install, list, uninstall, upgrade, path).

```bash
fobis pkg <install|list|path|upgrade|uninstall> [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Packages and indexes](/cookbook/packages#install-a-package-for-your-compiler).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

### `fobis pkg install`

Build a package with your compiler and install it into the store.

Arguments: `PACKAGE`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version` | TEXT |  | A version range (^1.2) or an exact tag. |
| `--compiler` | TEXT | `gnu` | Compiler family (gnu, intel_nextgen, ...). |
| `--fc` | TEXT |  | The Fortran compiler command (default: the family's). |
| `--mpi` |  |  | Build with the MPI wrapper (mpif90). |
| `--cflags` | TEXT |  | Flags added to the package's own (part of the key). |
| `--lflags` | TEXT |  | Link flags added (part of the key). |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Mode of the package's fobos to build. |
| `--bin-dir` | TEXT |  | Where applications are linked. |
| `--no-shims` |  |  | Do not link applications. |
| `--force` |  |  | Rebuild even when installed. |
| `--verbose` |  |  | Show the build's own output. |
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

### `fobis pkg list`

List the installed packages (name, version, toolchain key, build system).

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

### `fobis pkg path`

Print the install prefix of a package (for scripts, CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, PKG_CONFIG_PATH).

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--key` | TEXT |  | Toolchain key (when installed for several). |
| `--version` | TEXT |  | The installed version. |
| `--pkgconfig` |  |  | Print its pkg-config directory instead. |

### `fobis pkg uninstall`

Remove an installed package: exactly the files and links its install recorded.

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--key` | TEXT |  | Toolchain key (when installed for several). |
| `--version` | TEXT |  | The installed version. |

### `fobis pkg upgrade`

Install the newest version allowed by the original request, for the same toolchain; remove the old one.

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--bin-dir` | TEXT |  | Where applications are linked. |
| `--verbose` |  |  | Show the build's own output. |

<!-- cli:end -->
